## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Affected components

List the folders/components changed and link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

Record relevant checks and their results. Explain skipped checks. Include
screenshots for visible UI changes when useful.

## Deployment notes

Describe required migrations, environment variable changes or model deployments.
State whether these steps have been performed. Use placeholders for secrets.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused; unrelated components are unchanged.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass, or limitations are documented above.
- [ ] User-facing or setup documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private user data or restricted model weights are included.
